lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct horizontal tiers. The median row contains the largest and most intense local maxima, distributed with consistent spatial intervals posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from a high-intensity highlight on the dorsal edge to a deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated, low-luminance objects (commensal organisms) are visible in close proximity to the pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral head region.
